# Replace starter branding and sample content

Make the new repository's preview representative of its actual theme rather than a demo of the original template. Coordinate image samples with the hero-image issue.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Site title, description, author and other preview settings in `sample/appsettings.json` describe the new theme without changing the theme slug or link contract.
- [ ] Template-specific links and labels, including the GitHub link in `MainLayout.razor`, are replaced or removed appropriately.
- [ ] Sample posts and pages demonstrate the intended content, navigation, tags, locale handling and image use without losing useful preview coverage.
- [ ] Sample content and assets contain no private information or unlicensed material.
